mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, c.product_sku_id AS skuId, p.name AS productName, sku.sku_name AS skuName, COALESCE(sku.sku_image, p.main_image) AS imageUrl, sku.price AS unitPrice, sku.stock AS stock, c.quantity AS quantity, c.selected = 1 AS selected FROM cart c JOIN product_sku sku ON c.product_sku_id = sku.id JOIN product p ON sku.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}
